zh: durable state、immutable events 与 side-effect commands 必须分离
模型输出只提出 transition，runtime guard、authorization 与 invariant 决定合法性
tool call 使用稳定 callId、独立 attemptId，并区分 success、failure 与 outcome unknown
completion、approval 与 cancellation 都是可持久化 runtime transitions
en: Durable state, immutable events, and side-effect commands must remain separate
Model output proposes a transition while runtime guards, authorization, and invariants decide legality
A tool call uses a stable call ID, separate attempt IDs, and distinguishes success, failure, and unknown outcome
Completion, approval, and cancellation are durable runtime transitions

next.zh: 进入 structured concurrency：task group、dependency DAG、deadline/cancellation propagation、fan-out 限制、queue 与 backpressure。
next.en: Move into structured concurrency: task groups, dependency DAGs, deadline and cancellation propagation, bounded fan-out, queues, and backpressure.
